mesh.title: Shape & look
mesh.desc: Visible 3D shape or model with a material

camera.title: Camera
camera.desc: Shows the game world from this object

canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.desc: Where UI elements are drawn: the screen, or a place in the scene

collider.title: Collider
collider.desc: Lets the object touch and bump into others

text.title: Text
text.desc: On-screen text like score or messages

ui.title: UI element
ui.desc: Text, button, image, slider or panel

water.title: Water
water.desc: Lake or sea: things float, characters swim

animator.title: Animator
animator.desc: Plays model clips through an Animator Controller (states, transitions, blend trees)

volume.title: Post-processing volume
volume.desc: Puts a post-processing profile (glow, depth of field, vignette…) on the screen: everywhere, or while the camera is inside its box
